howtos.title: Switch Claude Desktop to the Latest release channel
howtos.what: Get more frequent Claude Desktop builds on Windows or Mac by opting in to the Latest channel.
copy: In Claude Desktop on Windows or Mac, open Settings > Desktop app.
Choose the Latest release channel for more frequent builds; Stable stays the default and Latest can be less reliable.
howtos.whenToUse: When you want new Claude Desktop features sooner and can accept builds that may be less reliable.
